propositions: inspect-ai is never imported anywhere in rebar source code; only the _optional.py registry name string references it
inspect-ai is the sole member of the [eval] extra and the sole cause of two [tool.uv] conflicts entries (eval vs bedrock, eval vs dev) and the click>=8.3.3 override
the click override exists solely to work around inspect-ai's stale cap (click < 8.2.2), which upstream fixed in 8.3.2 and held the entire project on vulnerable click 8.2.1
eval.py's module docstring falsely claims Inspect AI is routed through the live run, contradicting its own implementation comment stating the opposite
a pytest smoke test gated on [eval] would run in zero CI lanes because only the weekly dispatch job installs the extra and that job is pytest-less
removing inspect-ai, both conflicts, and the click override allows dev+bedrock and dev+eval to co-install, enabling eval tests to join the normal suite
